verdict: First Solar sold less but earned more: net sales fell 23% to $1.23B, yet EPS rose 25% to $5.30 as gross margin jumped to 58% of sales.

segments.name: Solar modules
segments.note: Sales of First Solar's American-made thin-film solar modules — its single product line. Sales fell 23% year over year, while the contracted backlog stood at 44.0 GW.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing the next generations of thin-film solar modules.

opex.name: Production start-up
opex.note: Costs of ramping new production lines before they reach full output.

otherDetail: Interest income of $24.2M and small foreign-exchange and other items added $19.9M; in addition, First Solar's income-tax line was a $5.0M benefit this quarter, which is counted inside this other-income line rather than as a tax cost.
footerNote: First Solar's tax line was a $5.0M benefit (a negative tax), so it is folded into other income above instead of appearing as a tax cost. Net cash balance was $1.5B at quarter end.

takeaways.title: Margin, not volume, drove profit
takeaways.text: Gross profit was $713M on $1.23B of sales — a 58% margin, up from 38% a year ago — reflecting the value of U.S. manufacturing tax credits and a richer sales mix, even as volumes fell.

takeaways.title: EPS rose 25% on lower sales
takeaways.text: Net income rose to $571M from $456M a year ago despite the 23% sales decline, and the board authorized a new $500M share-repurchase program.

takeaways.title: The order book is the cushion
takeaways.text: Contracted sales backlog of 44.0 GW gives First Solar years of committed demand for its U.S. factories, even when a single quarter's deliveries dip.
